frontmatter.sidebar_description: Create a payment collection for an order.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createOrderPaymentCollectionWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow creates a payment collection for an order. It's used by the
[Create Payment Collection Admin API Route](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#payment-collections\_postpaymentcollections).

You can use this workflow within your customizations or your own custom workflows, allowing you to wrap custom logic around
creating a payment collection for an order.
